brief: Security fix SEC-2. The planner's task card for this change is in docs/plans/2026-10-18-security-fix-specs.md (section SEC-2). Defect: the attribution string on approval surfaces ('task <id> "<brief>"'), built by label() in jarvis/v2/approvals.py for v2 and by _label in jarvis/tasks.py for v1, lets zero-width, bidi-override and other unseen characters (for example U+202E, U+200B, U+2066, NUL) from a model-written task brief through to the origin field of HUD and Discord approval cards, where they can reorder or hide text the owner reads before approving. Required behaviour: neither label contains such characters in the name or the id; the result is a single line; a name or id longer than 60 characters is capped and ends in an ellipsis (a name of exactly 60 is left whole); backticks are removed; the 'task <id> "..."' shape is unchanged; v1 and v2 give the same results for the same inputs. Constraints: write no new character table (reuse what the project already defines); if v1 must not import v2 code, say why in a comment; do not change permissions.py logic or the renderers; existing label-format assertions in tests/tasks_check.py and tests/dispatch_toolset_check.py keep passing.
